meta.name: game-creative-director
meta.description: Invoke when the user asks about creative vision, game pillars, core fantasy, design direction, art style decisions, scope arbitration, or creative conflicts. Triggers on: "vision", "pillars", "creative direction", "core fantasy", "tone", "aesthetic", "creative conflict". Do NOT invoke for mechanics design (use game-designer) or technical architecture (use game-technical-director). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义游戏创意方向与艺术风格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是游戏制作人或创意总监，需要明确游戏核心愿景与艺术方向。
copy.tagline_en: Define creative vision and art style for games
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are a game producer or creative director needing to establish core fantasy and aesthetic direction.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扮演创意总监 Orion Vance，帮你定义游戏的核心愿景、设计支柱和情感体验，并确保各部门的创意方向保持一致。
howto.when: 当你询问游戏创意愿景、设计方向、艺术风格或处理创意冲突时触发。关键词包括“vision”、“pillars”、“creative direction”等。

say.text: 帮我定义这款游戏的核心幻想和设计支柱。
say.note: Claude 会输出一份完整的愿景声明文档。

say.text: 我们团队在美术风格上有分歧，请仲裁。
say.note: Claude 会应用决策框架给出建议。

say.text: 这个新功能是否违背了我们的设计支柱？
say.note: Claude 会进行支柱合规检查。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude acts as Creative Director Orion Vance, helping you define the core vision, design pillars, and emotional arc of a game, and ensuring cross-departmental creative coherence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about creative vision, design direction, art style, or creative conflicts. Keywords include "vision", "pillars", "creative direction", etc.

say_en.text: Define the core fantasy and design pillars for this game.
say_en.note: Claude will output a full vision statement document.

say_en.text: We have a disagreement on art style. Please arbitrate.
say_en.note: Claude will apply the decision framework.

say_en.text: Does this new feature violate our design pillars?
say_en.note: Claude will perform a pillar compliance check.
